The '''Carida MedRec Storage Center''' was a records office located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] obtained [[General/Legends|General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge's]] medical records and psychological profile from a friend of his who worked at the facility.
